reasoning_traces.think:
The Data-Backed Content Primitive formalizes the core constraint that all narrative must derive from measurable, ingested data. It enforces a two-tier verification pipeline: the Free Preview acts as a conformal calibration set, while the Premium Article serves as an out-of-sample test. This mirrors leave-one-out cross-validation in predictive statistics. The No-Guaranteed-Outcomes rule prevents overconfidence by ensuring that all statements carry uncertainty; it is mathematically equivalent to requiring non-degenerate posterior distributions over game outcomes. Together, these primitives create a closed-loop system where generated content is simultaneously the output of the model and the dataset for evaluating its epistemic limits. Violations trigger immediate feedback, preventing systematic overfitting to editorial preferences.
